mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.parent_code, p.permission_type, p.sort_no, p.status FROM admin_permission p INNER JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.admin_id = #{adminId} AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, parent_code, permission_type, sort_no, status FROM admin_permission WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.parent_code, p.permission_type, p.sort_no, p.status FROM admin_permission p INNER JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_role_permission SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_role_permission (role_id, permission_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = 0
